Changelog

Every release of Flow PHP, in chronological order.

#[Unreleased] - 2026-11-04

#Added

  • #2724 - flow-php/web - Type-aware playground autocompletion for Flow API methods, DSL functions, classes and static members - @norberttech
  • #2724 - flow-php/web - Automatic use imports for completed DSL functions and classes - @norberttech
  • #2724 - flow-php/web - Playground hover docs, parameter hints, named argument and variable completion - @norberttech
  • #2724 - flow-php/web - Cmd/Ctrl+click in playground opens DSL, API or PHP manual documentation - @norberttech
  • #2724 - flow-php/web - Playground autocompletion for PHP functions and classes available in the playground - @norberttech
  • #2722 - flow-php/etl - PHP 8.5 pipe operator support: a pipeable DSL step for every DataFrame, GroupedDataFrame and Flow method - @norberttech
  • #2722 - flow-php/etl - Pipe operator documentation page - @norberttech

#Changed

  • #2725 - flow-php/flow - Website tests install only the Chromium headless shell - @norberttech
  • #2724 - flow-php/web - Playground formats code with Mago instead of PHP-CS-Fixer - @norberttech
  • #2724 - flow-php/web - API dump covers every class reachable from DSL functions - @norberttech
  • #2724 - flow-php/web - Tab accepts the selected playground suggestion - @norberttech
  • #2724 - flow-php/flow - Docs are built from source with Better Reflection, independent of loaded extensions - @norberttech
  • #2723 - flow-php/etl - DataFrame::cache() throws on an empty string id - @norberttech
  • #2722 - flow-php/etl - Transformation::transform() renamed to __invoke() - @norberttech
  • #2722 - flow-php/etl - WithColumn moved to API\Transformation and accepts Definition names and window functions - @norberttech
  • #2722 - flow-php/etl - DataFrame::with() accepts only Transformer or Transformation - @norberttech
  • #2722 - flow-php/etl - duplicate_row() refuses Definition names and window functions - @norberttech
  • #2722 - flow-php/etl - print_rows(Rows) renamed to format_rows() - @norberttech

#Fixed

  • #2724 - flow-php/web - Code samples link methods to their API documentation instead of same-named DSL functions - @norberttech
  • #2723 - flow-php/etl - cache("0") stores rows under the key "0" instead of the run id - @norberttech
  • #2722 - flow-php/etl - PHP 8.5 NaN-to-bool warning when evaluating a float column as a condition - @norberttech
  • #2722 - flow-php/etl - explain() default trigger in the documentation - @norberttech

#Removed

  • #2724 - flow-php/web - DSL definitions inlined into every page - @norberttech
  • #2724 - flow-php/flow - Stale psalm, phpstan and php-cs-fixer references - @norberttech
